_help.about: Empowering modifiers rolled onto Rare Golems from altars and the rare monsters of alien invasions (how many per stage is set in stages.json > altar / invasion > modifiers). Entries with "disabled": true are skipped. Effects from several modifiers add up.
_help.name: Shown on the boss bar and the spawn banner.
_help.color: Name color and the color of the aura particles.
_help.weight: How often it is rolled compared with others (0 = never).
_help.minStage: Earliest danger stage it can appear on (0 = the first stage).
_help.ais: Optional: only roll it onto monsters with one of these ai values (dog, crow, pumpkin, golem).
_help.effects: Any mix of: hp, damage, speed, size (extra fractions, 0.5 = +50%), armor (fraction of damage ignored, total capped at 0.75), regen (fraction of max health healed per second), healOnHit (fraction of max health healed whenever it hurts you), attackSpeed (faster wind-ups and recoveries, 0.5 = 50% faster), boulders (extra boulders per throw), summons (extra pack calls), slamRadius (bigger ground slam), lavaTrail (leaves burning ground that deals this fraction of its damage per second), deathBlast (explodes when killed for this many times its damage, after a warning), dotImmune (true = ignores poison and bleed), pulse (every 2.5 seconds it hits you wherever you are for this share of its damage and shoves you away from it; each pulse is 25% stronger than the last, until it dies), anchor (true = it uses the boss anchor ability: stand in a circle or it explodes on you), shamanic (every 3 seconds it fires a ring of 8 purple hexes that hit for this share of its damage and poison you), shroud (radius in meters of the circle around it: it only takes damage while you stand inside), inflicts (statuses its hits can put on you, with a chance each, e.g. {"slow": 1, "stun": 0.3}; also poison and bleed, damage over time on you; see status_effects.json).
_help.dungeon: Optional: false = never rolled as a dungeon modifier (stages.json dungeon), e.g. abilities that would be too much on every monster of a pack.

modifiers.name: Regenerating
modifiers.desc: Heals 1% of its max health every second.

modifiers.name: Colossal
modifiers.desc: Bigger, tougher, and its slam reaches further.

modifiers.name: Vampiric
modifiers.desc: Heals 6% of its max health whenever it hurts you.

modifiers.name: Warlord
modifiers.desc: Calls its pack from the caves twice.

modifiers.name: Static
modifiers.desc: Its hits often shock you, so you take more damage.

modifiers.name: Entangling
modifiers.desc: Its hits can root you in place.

modifiers.name: Relentless
modifiers.desc: Pulses at you wherever you are, harder every time, until slain.

modifiers.name: Doombringer
modifiers.desc: Marks the ground under you. Stand in the mark or it explodes.

modifiers.name: Shamanic
modifiers.desc: Every few seconds it fires a ring of purple hexes that poison you.

modifiers.name: Shrouded
modifiers.desc: A shroud surrounds it: you can only hurt it while you stand inside the circle around it.
